prompt.text: Late autumn afternoon in an old sandstone arcade beside a courtyard. A 25-year-old adult Japanese woman stands in a band of low, hard sunlight between two arches and turns her face toward the sun on the left, eyes softly half-closed, with a calm, private half-smile; her body is angled toward the light, one shoulder resting against a sandstone column, one hand loosely holding the edge of her coat at her chest. She has natural fair, cool-toned skin, an oval face with long narrow eyes and a straight nose, a clean base with precise eyeliner and a muted rose-red lip, and long deep wine-red brown hair in a loose, soft low chignon with a few strands framing her face. Curvy figure, 166 cm tall, bust 92 cm, waist 58 cm, hips 90 cm, F cup, a slim waist. She wears a black fine-knit square-neck midi dress, a camel wool coat draped over her shoulders with her arms out of the sleeves, and small gold hoop earrings. Light: the sun lays a warm band across her face, neck and shoulders, so her face is the focal point of the picture, its highlights keeping their detail, with crisp natural shadows; the sunlit floor bounces a little warm light into the shade. Setting: plain walls with no signs, a few yellow leaves, nobody else around; on the left behind her, a row of round arches recedes into cool shade striped with sunlight. Shot: knee-up, from a little above her head to just above her knees; her feet are out of the frame. Camera: vertical 3:4, at her chest height, a 50mm lens from about 2 metres, natural perspective with straight vertical lines. Composition: she stands slightly right of centre and fills most of the frame height; the column is only a narrow strip of shaded stone at the right edge, partly cut off by the frame, so it frames her without drawing the eye. Colours: black, camel, sandstone gold and the wine-red of her hair. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.

self_check.verdict: 部分通過（Claude 自查）：比 R14 明顯好看。景別拉近、光真正落在人身上、手勢讓姿態鬆開；仍看鏡頭而不是迎光半閉眼，柱子比計畫的「一窄條」寬
self_check.appeal: 整張有秋日午後的溫度與私密感，人物是畫面主角，已接近可收的寫真；是否收由主管看圖、Penny 決定
self_check.facing_light: 未達：她正面看鏡頭、淺笑，沒有轉向光、也沒有半閉眼；表情自然不僵
self_check.light_on_person: 有：暖色陽光落在臉、頸、肩與大衣，臉部高光保有細節；光偏柔和，不是很硬的光帶；左側地面有陽光條紋
self_check.blend: 肩靠石柱自然，人與迴廊同一光線，人景融合比 R14 好
self_check.column: 仍偏大：石柱占右側約三分之一，雖在暖光中、紋理好看、也是她倚靠的支點，但不是計畫中被畫面切掉的一窄條
self_check.pose_identity: 一手輕抓胸前大衣邊、一手在下方扶著大衣，雙臂不再垂直下垂；與 identity_master、R14 是同一人
self_check.framing: 頭頂留白適中；下緣約在大腿到膝蓋之間、腳不入鏡，沒有截斷問題；3:4 不裁切、約 325 ppi
self_check.technical: 清晰，臉、手細節正常；無招牌字、無白邊、無雜物；左上角兩盞吊燈屬場景；左手處大衣看起來可能有一側穿袖，與「披肩不穿袖」略有出入，屬小問題
